study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Fraza et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Unraveling the link between CNVs, cognition and individual neuroimaging deviation scores from a population-based reference cohort

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: UK Biobank was used for both IDP-based normative model (analysis 1) and Jacobian voxel-based normative model (analysis 2). Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS-3, and PNC were combined with UK Biobank data to create the Jacobian normative model spanning the entire age range. CNV carriers were identified from UK Biobank only.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: For the genetic CNV data, we focused on the 92 CNVs proposed to be pathogenic, which can be requested from https://biobank.ndph.ox.ac.uk/ukb/app.cgi?id=14421... we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC and UK Biobank, leveraging Jacobian determinant images from nonlinear image registration

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Analysis 1 used UK Biobank IDPs (44,456 participants total, 263 with pathogenic CNVs). Analysis 2 used pooled Jacobian data from 5 repositories (19,620 quality-controlled participants, 375 with pathogenic CNVs). A 50-50 train-test split was used, with test set including all participants with pathogenic CNVs.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Our dataset was divided into a 50-50 train-test split, with the test set including all participants with pathogenic CNVs... In total, we used 44,456 participants in the IDP study, and in the Jacobian-voxel-based study, 19,620 participants passed visual quality control.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Normative model formulation, L205; Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Study workflow and data summary, L326-L327

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: For IDP model (analysis 1): 43,893 participants without pathogenic CNVs (total 44,456 minus 263 with CNVs, but CNV carriers were placed in test set so HC for normative model is 43,893). For Jacobian model (analysis 2): total 19,620 passed QC, minus 375 CNV carriers = 19,245 healthy controls. A 50-50 train-test split was used, but exact train N is not reported. The test set included all CNV carriers.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: In total, for the IDP study, we used 43,893 participants, and for the Jacobian-voxel-based study, we used 19,620 visually quality-controlled participants... There were 375 individuals with pathogenic CNVs in the quality-controlled Jacobian neuroimaging dataset... Our dataset was divided into a 50-50 train-test split, with the test set including all participants with pathogenic CNVs.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model 1 (IDP): Based on UKB-IDP sample demographics. Model 2 (Jacobian): Pooled from 5 sites. Weighted mean calculated as: (656*54.93 + 1112*28.80 + 2144*70.60 + 1296*14.37 + 14412*62.50) / 19620 = 55.02 years. Age range spans from 8 years (PNC minimum) to 97 years (OASIS 3 maximum).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1: UKB-IDP N=43,893, Mean age (s.d.)=60.97 (8.72), Age range=44-82. Table 2: Cam-CAN Mean age=54.93 (18.60), Age range=18-89; HCP Mean age=28.80 (3.70), Age range=22-37; OASIS 3 Mean age=70.60 (9.52), Age range=43-97; PNC Mean age=14.37 (3.45), Age range=8-21; UKB Mean age=62.50 (7.48), Age range=44-80

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model 1 (IDP): 43,893 * 52.4% = 23,001 females; 43,893 * 47.6% = 20,892 males. Model 2 (Jacobian): Weighted by sample size from Table 2 (excluding CNV carriers). Cam-CAN: 50.6%/49.4%, HCP: 54.5%/45.5%, OASIS-3: 56.8%/43.2%, PNC: 51.9%/48.1%, UKB: 52.6%/47.4%. Weighted average female%: (656*0.506 + 1112*0.545 + 2144*0.568 + 1296*0.519 + 14412*0.526)/19620 = 52.8%. Female_n estimated: 19245 * 0.528 = 10,161 (approximate), Male_n: 19245 * 0.472 = 9,084 (approximate).
